title: BanG Dream! Yume∞Mita Series Confirms New Anime in Production
content:
The official X/Twitter account for the BanG Dream! franchise announced on Friday that the BanG Dream! Yume∞Mita series inspired by the BanG Dream! project's Mugendai Mewtype (also known as YumeMita) virtual girl band has a new anime in production.

The Mugendai Mewtype virtual girl band is composed of Arale Nakamachi on vocals, Nonoka Miyanaga on guitar, Ritsu Minetsuki on guitar, Miyako Fuji on keyboard, and the band's DJ and manipulator Yuno Sengoku .

Artist Kuunerin launched the BanG Dream! Yume∞Mita Arale∞Arabu-ration manga on Bushiroad Works ' Comic Growl (formerly Comic Bushiroad Web ) manga website on July 24.

Bushiroad launched the BanG Dream! multimedia project in January 2015. The main BanG Dream! television anime's first 13-episode season premiered in January 2017. The BanG Dream! 3rd Season television anime premiered in January 2020.

The franchise also includes the BanG Dream! FILM LIVE and BanG Dream! FILM LIVE 2nd Stage films, the two-part BanG Dream! Episode of Roselia films, as well as several web anime spinoff series.
author: ANN

title: Supporting Cast for 'Kaketa Tsuki no Mercedes' Announced
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Firehead 's Kaketa Tsuki no Mercedes: Kyuuketsuki no Kizoku ni Tensei shita kedo Suteraresou nanode Dungeon wo Seiha suru ( Mercedes and the Waning Moon: The Dungeoneering Feats of a Discarded Vampire Aristocrat ) light novel revealed supporting cast and second visual (pictured). The anime will premiere on January 10 at 4:30 p.m. on TBS-affiliated networks across Japan, airing every Sunday on 28 stations.

Cast Margitte Grunewald: Nichika Oomori ( Yuusha no Kuzu ) Monica Grunewald: Miyu Tomita ( Himekishi wa Barbaroi no Yome ) Bernhard Grunewald: Show Hayami ( Neko to Ryuu )

Kunihisa Sugishima ( Slime Taoshite 300-nen, Shiranai Uchi ni Level Max ni Nattemashita: Sono Ni ) is directing the anime at Teddy . Jun Kumagai ( Mizu Zokusei no Mahoutsukai ) is handling the series composition. Nami Shouyama ( Buddy Daddies animation director) is designing the characters, while R・O・N ( Kuroko no Basket ) and Shuuhei Mutsuki ( Lycoris Recoil ) and composing the music.

Firehead originally began writing the adventure fantasy novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in October 2018. TO Books began printing the series featuring illustrations by KeG ( Gaikotsu Kishi-sama, Tadaima Isekai e Odekakechuu ) in May 2021 and released the fourth volume in August 2025. The fifth volume went on sale on July 15.

A manga adaptation by Pochi Edoya ( Mahou Shoujo Ikusei Keikaku manga) began on the Corona EX website in August 2021. TO Books published the sixth volume on July 15.

J-Novel Club licensed both the light novel and manga in English for digital release in November 2024 and released the fourth novel volume on February 13. The fifth manga volume was published on August 5.

title: Witch Hat Atelier Returns With New Look at Most Beloved Character Ahead of Season 2
content:
While fans are awaiting Witch Hat Atelier Season 2, the anime drops a gorgeous new visual of Qifrey. Witch Hat Atelier is easily one of the biggest anime of the year, and fans will see the return of their beloved characters next year. Produced by studio BUG FILMS, this breathtaking anime is based on the manga written and illustrated by Kamone Shirahama , which has been serialized in Kodansha’s seinen magazine Morning Two since 2016. The first season has only introduced the premise of this whimsical fantasy, but things will get more intense in the sequel season.

One of the characters at the center of attention will be Qifrey, who became a fan-favorite after the anime debut. Whether it’s his moral ambiguity, his skills, or his goal that he is desperate to accomplish, everything about him easily makes him the most captivating character in the story. November 19th is his birthday, and to commemorate the special day, Kairi Unabara drew a gorgeous visual of Qifrey holding a bouquet of flowers. Unabara serves as the Chief Animation Director and the character designer of the anime. The birthday visual was shared by the official X handle of the anime , which immediately went viral as fans can’t help but adore Unabara’s stunning art style.

Does Witch Hat Atelier Season 2 Have a Release Date?

So far, the anime has only confirmed a 2027 release window, but it has yet to lock down an exact release date. Fans don’t even know which season’s lineup will include the anime, but we can expect an update when next year begins. Additionally, the second season will be streaming on Crunchyroll, where you can also catch up with the first season to jog your memory. Before each anime season, Crunchyroll reveals a lineup that includes the release dates, the English dub confirmation, and the streaming timing. We can expect all streaming information related to Witch Hat Atelier Season 2 to be added on the website a few weeks ahead of the premiere.

Witch Hat Atelier Will Get More Intense in Season 2

The anime ended its first season on a major cliffhanger in the middle of an attack in the Serpentback Cave. The story takes a turn for the worse in the finale since it’s evident Qifrey needs to fight his hardest to keep his apprentices safe. A teaser was also revealed along with the second season announcement in June this year, which shared a glimpse at a dark appearance of Coco.

This clearly means she will be tapping into a new kind of power that she might not have enough control over. The story finally took shape in the first season, but it keeps gradually building up the fact that the world of magic has something much darker and dangerous lurking around. Coco and her fellow apprentices will definitely break more norms and tap into more secrets of the world.

Are you excited for Qifrey’s return in Witch Hat Atelier Season 2? Which moment of this beloved character was your favorite in the first season? Let us know in the comments below.

title: Crunchyroll Streams My Hero Academia The Movie: World Heroes' Mission Anime
content:
The film opened in August 2021 in Japan, and had earned a cumulative total of 3,183,773,400 yen (about US$28.68 million) as of September 2021.

In the story of My Hero Academia THE MOVIE: World Heroes' Mission , a mysterious organization dedicated to the destruction of people with Quirks has issued a threat and set bombs all over the world. Pro Heroes and those in Hero Internships scramble to find the bombs. Deku, Bakugo, and Todoroki encounter Rody, a boy living in a mobile home in their designated area of Otheon, and end up working with him.

Original manga creator Kōhei Horikoshi again served as chief supervisor and original character designer. Kenji Nagasaki returned from the television series and two previous films in the franchise to direct the new film at BONES . Other returning staff members include scriptwriter Yousuke Kuroda , character designer Yoshihiko Umakoshi , and composer Yūki Hayashi . Asian Kung-Fu Generation performed the film's theme song "Empathy" and the film's insert song "Flowers."

The My Hero Academia: You're Next film, the franchise 's fourth film, opened in Japan in August 2024. TOHO International started screening the film in U.S. theaters in October 2024.

Kōhei Horikoshi ended the magazine serialization of the original My Hero Academia manga in August 2024 (although he added 38 pages of new content in the manga's 42nd and final compiled book volume in December 2024). The anime adaptation premiered its final season in October 2025. The anime's bonus episode titled "More," based on the manga's extra 431st chapter following the original finale, aired on May 2.
author: ANN

title: 'BanG Dream! Yume∞Mita' New Anime in Production
content:
The 3rd Anniversary livestream event of Mugendai MewType announced a new anime for BanG Dream! Yume∞Mita television anime on Friday.

Produced by Nichicaline , the 13-episode series aired in Summer 2026. Crunchyroll streamed the anime in English subtitles.

The first television anime of the multimedia franchise, abbreviated as Bandori , was produced by Xebec and Issen in Winter 2017. A second season by SANZIGEN premiered in Winter 2019, followed by a third season in Winter 2020. The BanG Dream!: Poppin' Dream! movie, taking place after the third season, opened in Japan in January 2022.

The BanG Dream! Film Live and BanG Dream! Film Live 2nd Stage anime movies premiered in September 2019 and August 2021. The Episode of Roselia movies, Yakusoku and Song I Am. , opened in theaters in April and June in 2021.

The BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!! television anime premiered in Summer 2023, followed by the BanG Dream! Ave Mujica ( Ave Mujica: The Die is Cast ) sequel in Winter 2025. The latest movie, BanG Dream! Ave Mujica Movie opened in Japanese theaters on October 16. The upcoming installment, BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!! / Ave Mujica television anime is scheduled to premiere on January 8, 2027.

title: Maison and the Man-Eating Apartment Manga Ends in Next Chapter
content:
The 47th chapter of Kuu Tanaka and Akima 's Maison and the Man-Eating Apartment ( Hitokui Mansion to Ōya no Maison ) manga revealed on Friday the series will end with its next chapter on December 4.

Shueisha 's MANGA Plus publishes the manga in English, and it describes the story:

The clock strikes at the single second before the end of the world. Yet humanity has escaped extinction and carry on with their daily lives in the strange and terrible apartment where time stands still. A young girl Maison, Landlord by birth, is on the brink of revealing its secrets... An astonishing sci-fi fantasy saga brought to you by a visionary duo!

Tanaka and Akima launched the manga in Shonen Jump+ in March 2025. Shueisha published the manga's fifth compiled book volume on October 2, and will publish the sixth volume on January 4.

The 19th Manga Taisho awards ranked the manga in 11th place earlier this year.

Tanaka launched the The Vertical World ( Tate no Kuni ) manga on Shonen Jump+ in September 2019, and ended it in April 2021. Shueisha 's MANGA Plus website added the manga in English in November 2019.

Tanaka, Yuu Kuraishi , and Kazu Inabe 's AIDOL manga serialized on Kodansha 's Comic Days platform from April 2019 to August 2022. Kodansha published four volumes for the manga. Kodansha USA Publishing licensed the manga and will release it this fall.

Akima and Kanae Nakanishi launched the Shojo Null manga on Shonen Jump+ platform in August 2023, and ended it in September 2024. Shueisha shipped the four volumes for the manga. Viz Media licensed the series, and released the fourth volume in October 2025.
author: ANN

title: BanG Dream! Yume∞Mita Gets New Anime Series
content:
Mugendai MewType announced during their 3rd anniversary livestream that BanG Dream! Yume∞Mita is getting a new anime series. It was not confirmed whether the new anime will be a TV or movie format and if it’s a sequel.

Also Read: BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA Episode 12 Is Exactly the Reason Why Miyako Is the Best BanG Dream! Releases Yumemita x Our Notes Story Trailer

The previous BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA anime was animated by NICHICALINE and has 13 episodes in total. Tomomi Umezu was the director and Hiroshi Morita was the assistant director. Midori Goto handled series composition, while Osamu Nobusawa and Mochipuyo handled character design. The cast includes:

• Arale Nakamachi (vocals)

• Nonoka Miyanaga (lead guitar)

• Ritsu Minetsuki (rhythm guitar)

• Miyako Fuji (keyboard)

• Yuno Sengoku (DJ)

• Kaede Hondo as Viola

• Wakana Maruoka as Bell

• Yui Tsukada as Popo

• Runa Sanai as Manager

• Maaya Uchida as Koharu

• Konomi Kohara as Kaede

• Miho Okasaki as Yuina

Muse Asia streams the anime, describing it as follows: “Waaaaaah!!” Thrown together out of the blue to make their debut, these members each have a spark of unique talent—but they are in absolutely no shape to actually be a band. Can these girls, and their band, really survive this!? “Even when the sound stops, fight back.” Source: Official X (formerly Twitter) © BanG Dream! Project
author: Anime Corner

title: Mitei Hattori's Smile! Manga Gets Epilogue Chapter
content:
Kyodo Printing Co., Ltd. 's Kodama Tales Inc. subsidiary releases the main Smile! manga in English, and it describes the story:

Yuushi Kamome is a freelance journalist who lost his beloved daughter in an unforeseen accident. His descent into despair following her death drove his wife to leave him, and he lives each day a shell of the man he once was. But his fate changes one day when members from a religious organization he had never heard of, the Smiling Hearts Society, knock on his door and hand him a flyer. He's ready to dismiss them until he notices the face of his estranged wife on the flyer, smiling ever so softly. And so begins a tale of religion and insanity. What kind of sinister darkness lurks behind this religion and its strange smiles?

Hattori launched the series in Nihonbungeisha 's Weekly Manga Goraku magazine in 2021. The series ended in March 2025. Nihonbungeisha shipped the 11th and final compiled book volume in March 2025. Kodama Tales released the fifth volume on September 1.

title: Life with an Ordinary Guy Who Reincarnated into a Total Fantasy Knockout Manga Ends With 20th Volume
content:
Seven Seas Entertainment is releasing the manga in English, and it describes the story:

Nerdy office worker Hinata has once again blundered at a singles mixer, no thanks to his hunky best friend, Jinguji, who's always by his side. While he's grumbling about it on the way home, a naked goddess appears out of nowhere and sends the two friends to another world--while also turning Hinata into a hot young woman! To get back Hinata's original body, Hinata and Jinguji set off on a journey to defeat the demon king, even if Hinata's new feminine form is giving them...unexpected feelings. Can they save this fantasy world before their lifelong bromance becomes a romance?

Tsurusaki and Ikezawa launched the manga in Cycomi in November 2019. Seven Seas Entertainment released the 10th volume on August 4.

The manga inspired a television anime that premiered in January 2022. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan, and also streamed an English dub .
